rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for temporarily taking an object and intending to return it; with money, speakers usually say 借錢 instead.

example.english: Can I borrow a pen from you?
example.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 zi1 bat1 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically when borrowing money from a person, bank, or other lender for later repayment.

example.english: I want to borrow money to buy a new computer.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 ze3 cin2 maai5 bou6 san1 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this for adopting or using someone else’s idea, style, or a word from another language, rather than temporarily taking a physical object.

example.english: Some Cantonese words are ones we borrow from English.
example.traditional: 廣東話入面有啲詞語係借用英文嘅。
example.jyutping: gwong2 dung1 waa2 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 ci4 jyu5 hai6 ze3 jung6 jing1 man4 ge3
